Physical Home SecurityBurglars often look for "soft targets" with easy points of entry. Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)MFA is one of the most effective ways to prevent unauthorized access to your accounts. Even if someone steals your password, they cannot log in without a second "factor" (like a code from an app or a physical security key).Getty Images4.
